title: Crowd Rush
tagline: Steer through the gates. Grow the crowd. Crush the boss.
hook: The crowd is already running when the ad appears. A finger slides left and right to show the only control, and the first gate arrives in about a second, with two good choices so the first decision always rewards the player.
coreLoop: Steer left or right to pick one gate in each row. Plus and times gates grow the crowd, minus and divide gates shrink it. After six rows the crowd meets a boss crowd, and the bigger one wins. The levels come from a seed, and there is always a path that wins.

levers.name: One control
levers.why: A mechanic that needs no explanation removes the main reason to leave in the first seconds.
levers.how: Drag to steer on a phone, move the mouse on a desktop. A sliding finger shows it, and it shakes faster after 2.5 idle seconds.

levers.name: Instant reward
levers.why: The first choice decides whether the ad feels generous.
levers.how: Both gates in the first row are good, so the player is rewarded whichever side they take. Later rows have one good and one bad gate.

levers.name: Visible growth
levers.why: Seeing the number and the crowd grow is the whole pleasure of the genre.
levers.how: The crowd is an instanced mesh of up to 160 blobs, and the counter floats above it. Big gains add a field-of-view kick and a rising arpeggio.

levers.name: Readable risk
levers.why: The player must see which gate is bad before choosing, or a loss feels unfair.
levers.how: Blue gates add or multiply, red gates subtract or divide. The label is drawn on each gate, and the road shows both sides at once.

levers.name: Boss tension
levers.why: A final fight gives the run an ending and turns the crowd size into a result.
levers.how: A BOSS AHEAD warning, then the two crowds shrink against each other with sparks, shake and short vibrations. The enemy is 65 percent of the best possible crowd, so a few mistakes still win.

levers.name: Second chance with a gift
levers.why: A loss that offers something to come back for keeps the player.
levers.how: The first failure offers TRY AGAIN with 12 extra crowd members. The second failure leaves only the install button.

events.name: impression
events.meaning: The ad is ready and visible, and the run starts.

events.name: first_input
events.meaning: Milliseconds from start to the first steering input. The key hook metric.

events.name: gate
events.meaning: A gate was passed. Carries row, operation, value, and the crowd before and after.

events.name: bad_gate
events.meaning: The player took a subtract or divide gate.

events.name: idle_nudge
events.meaning: Nobody steered for 2.5 seconds and the finger sped up.

events.name: boss_start
events.meaning: The final fight began. Carries the crowd and the enemy size.

events.name: fail
events.meaning: The run was lost. Carries the reason, the crowd or the boss.

events.name: retry
events.meaning: The player used the second chance and took the bonus crowd.

events.name: win
events.meaning: The boss was beaten. Carries the number of survivors.

events.name: end_card
events.meaning: The end card is shown. Carries outcome, stars, crowd and enemy.

events.name: cta_click
events.meaning: The install button was pressed. Carries where it was pressed.
